```plato
    //==
    // # Point support
    //
    // The IDifference obligations of Point2D/Point3D, point interpolation, and the
    // explicit point <-> vector converters that every other transform library builds
    // on. Kept separate from the representations because nothing here depends on a
    // transform type.

    //==
    // Point support — the IOriginBased conversions of Point2D/Point3D/PointN, and
    // the explicit point <-> vector converters spelled in the direction callers
    // read them.
    //
    // NOTHING else is written here. Add, Between, Subtract (both spellings) and
    // Lerp are all derived from Offset and FromOffset via algebra.library.plato.
    // The converters remain deliberately named
    // rather than implicit conversions: silently coercing between positions and
    // displacements would defeat the point of keeping them distinct types.

    // The point's displacement from the origin.
    Offset(p: Point2D): Vector2D
        => (p.X, p.Y);
```

```plato
    // The point's displacement from the origin. Arity is carried by the
    // component array, so no separate arity argument is needed.
    // Written as an explicit construction, not a parenthesized value: the single field is an
    // Array, and a C# backend cannot declare the implicit conversion for an interface-typed
    // field (CS0552), so the structural form has nothing to convert through.
    Offset(p: PointN): VectorN
        => VectorN(p.Components);
```
